subject: Observability add-ons — retention / tracing / dashboards price and credit schedule
messages:
From: Claire Benton <claire@scalehealth.ai>
To: diego.fernandez@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Observability add-ons — retention / tracing / dashboards price and credit schedule

Diego —

Thanks for the demo last week. The team here liked the tracing views and the retention controls for our audit requirements. Before we move to an internal approval, procurement asked for a clear add-on pricing breakdown (retention tiers, tracing sampling, advanced dashboards) and whether Redwood can provide a pilot credit or usage-based discount for the first 90 days.

High level context: we expect ~1.2B tokens/month of inference, and high cardinality traces during product launches (spikes up to 5x). We care about a predictable monthly cost and the ability to retain traces for 180 days for certain projects.

Can you send a simple tiered price sheet and a proposed credit schedule we could present to finance? Also attaching a CSV with our token profile from the trial (will send in follow-ups).

Appreciate it —
Claire Benton
VP, Engineering
Scale Health
--
Attachment: (will attach usage file in follow-up)

From: diego.fernandez@redwood.ai <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Benton <claire@scalehealth.ai>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 23 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons — retention / tracing / dashboards price and credit schedule

Claire —

Thanks for the clear ask and for the token profile context. I pulled together a concise breakdown (attached) and sketched a credit schedule we typically offer for new enterprise customers committing to Dedicated or a defined hosted spend. High-level summary here: 

- Retention tiers (per-hosted-account/month):
  • 30 days: $0 (included)
  • 90 days: $2,500
  • 180 days: $6,500
- Tracing (sampling and storage): $0.02 per trace-minute beyond baseline 100k trace-minutes/month
- Advanced dashboards: $1,000 per seat per month or $8k/month flat for up to 8 editor seats (preferred for product/ops teams)

Pilot/credit options we can offer:
- One-time onboarding credit equal to 1 month of expected add-on spend (applies to first invoice)
- Alternatively, a 20% credit on add-on invoices for first 90 days if you sign a 12-month commitment on hosted usage or reserved Dedicated capacity

I attached the redwood-observability-pricing-v2.pdf and a quick example tab with your trial token profile mapped to cost. If you can confirm which commitment path you prefer (12-month reserved vs. hosted usage with seasonal bursts) I can loop in Marissa to get approval for the 20% pilot credit or propose a custom credit schedule.

Quick ask: please share the Q2 CSV you mentioned with the daily token distribution and trace-minute spikes; that will help me model the expected add-on spend more precisely.

Thanks —
Diego Fernandez
Senior Sales Rep, Redwood Inference
Diego Fernandez | redwood.inference
--
Attachment: redwood-observability-pricing-v2.pdf (PDF, 84 KB)

Diego / Marissa —

Attached the usage CSV (Q2 daily tokens + trace-minute estimates). A few clarifications:
- Our spikes last 2-3 days and happen twice a quarter during major releases.
- For compliance projects we'd need 180-day retention for two service teams (approx 20% of traffic).
- We're leaning toward hosted with a 12-month consumption forecast (not reserved Dedicated yet).

Requested ask from finance: can Redwood front-load an onboarding credit equal to 1 month of projected add-on spend (applied as a line-item credit), and confirm that the 20% pilot credit is only available when we sign a 12-month committed spend? Procurement also needs a rough amortization example (how credits will appear on monthly invoices).

Thanks — attaching usage_report_Q2.csv

Claire Benton

Scale Health

From: diego.fernandez@redwood.ai <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, Claire Benton <claire@scalehealth.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 10:46:00 -07:00
Subject: FW: Observability add-ons — proposed credit schedule (internal approval request)

Marissa —

Forwarding Claire's usage file and the pricing draft. They prefer hosted with a 12-month consumption forecast. Procurement asks for: (1) a one-time onboarding credit equal to 1 month of projected add-on spend applied as a credit line, and (2) confirmation that the 20% pilot credit only applies if they sign a 12-month commitment.

I modeled three scenarios in the attached PDF: conservative / expected / peak. For Scale Health's expected profile, add-on spend = ~$18k/month; onboarding credit = $18k one-time; 20% pilot credit (if we approve) would be applied to add-on invoices for first 90 days (~$10.8k credit). Net effective reduction in first quarter with both would be ~70% of one-month spend (example broken out in the PDF).

Recommendation: approve onboarding credit (one-time) for this account; approve 20% pilot credit for first 90 days contingent on a signed 12-month hosted consumption MOU. If you prefer, we can trade some of the credit for a slightly higher minimum commitment or a short-term volume ramp clause.

If approved, I'll draft a short SOW and the invoice note (amortization example) and send to procurement.

Diego
Senior Sales Rep, Redwood Inference
--
Attachment: redwood-addons-draft-sow.docx (DOCX, 46 KB)

From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons — retention / tracing / dashboards price and credit schedule

Diego / Claire —

Approved. We can offer: 

1) One-time onboarding credit equal to 1 month of projected add-on spend (applied as a single credit line on first invoice).
2) 20% credit on add-on invoices for the first 90 days, conditional on a signed 12-month hosted consumption commitment (we'll capture the commitment in a short MOU and include the credit clause).

Marissa requested I add two guardrails: credits expire if the customer cancels within the first 120 days (to prevent churn gaming), and the credit will be reconciled against actual usage at the end of Q1 (true-up).

Claire — I dropped a draft SOW and a DocuSign envelope link here for your review: https://app.redwood-inference.com/sow/RWI-2026-078/draft and https://www.docusign.com/DocuSignEnvelope/RWI-2026-078. Once you confirm, Diego will finalize the invoice wording so procurement can process.

Happy to discuss by quick call if helpful.

Best —
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Exec, Redwood Inference
